text.text_excerpt: Blue Plate is more than just mayonnaise. It's the best damn mayonnaise you're ever taste and the last mayonnaise you'll ever use. While available in a decent sized region of the South, Blue Plate has its origins in the GNO. Until not too entirely long ago there was even a Blue Plate factory right in Mid City. In fact, that location is still used as a landmark. So put down that other crap and get Blue Plate. Your taste buds will thank me later.

For those people that think any mayonnaise will do, you are absolutely wrong. Blue Plate is the only mayo you should be using. I am not always the quickest to realize when something is wrong. Oftentimes I will do something over and over again before realizing there is a problem. That is how I learned that Blue Plate is the best mayo. For years I would just pick up the cheap store brand mayo whenever I went to the store. I couldn't understand why my sandwiches weren't as good as I remembered from when I was a kid. After a couple of years of using the lame mayo, I had a po-boy at a local joint where I could watch them make my sandwich. They used Blue Plate and the sandwich was great so I fi...

For review 1100 I've chosen the quintessential NOLA condiment. Forget your other schmeers...Blue Plate is where it's at. I know it's not made in town anymore but that doesn't matter. If I'm buying mayo, I'm buying BP. Bonus star for the awesome old factory at the Jeff Davis/Earhart/Washington Ave traffic snarl that is now apartments.
